notes.title: DreadMoon Co-op Campaign DLC Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey DreadMoon Community,

We are beyond excited to announce that the DreadMoon Co-op Campaign DLC is finally here! Gather your friends and dive into an 8-player co-op experience like no other. Traverse unique environments, face off against a variety of enemy types, and explore the lore of DreadMoon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/9796a7ad5792e6f010c660607af9352093c7f2ab.jpg[/img]

In this new co-op campaign, you'll encounter hidden seals scattered throughout the levels, offering unique challenges and rewards for those daring enough to seek them out.

We want to be transparent with you all—this DLC is in Early Access. We're a small, passionate dev team working tirelessly to bring you the best experience possible, and your feedback is invaluable to us.

In addition to the new campaign, we’ve rolled out some exciting updates:

New UI: Streamlined and more intuitive, enhancing your gameplay experience.
Graphical Updates: Improved visuals to make your journey through DreadMoon even more immersive.
Thank you for your continued support. Dive in, explore, and let us know what you think!

See you in the game,

The FatalFox Studios Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/f42d06b35c3c1f1f21807dc072b941b50ca813cb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1r - Tournament Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Content[/b]

[b]Tournament mode[/b]
- This allows players to create a tournament room where the host is a spectator (perfect for our streamers). 
- Players can select the teams that they want to be on.
- For the host spectator, we allow a free camera using WASD movement and POV swapping using your shoot button to swap between players' POVs.

[b]Map fixes[/b]
- Resolved minor terrain issues.

[b]Controller changes[/b]
- Added aim assist
- Added aim acceleration
- Changed how the weapon wheel works on controller. Right stick is now used to determine which weapon to select

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed ping only showing for host
- Fixed an issue where grenade launcher shots would explode on invisible walls
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Madness seal wasn't properly randomizing weapon and ammo pickups
- Fixed several issues related to inputs being able to be received while the weapon wheel was open
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Eternal seal wouldn't allow players to swap to guns that were previously out of ammo
- Fixed an issue in Seal the Deal where the Eternal seal wouldn't allow low ammo weapons to load the full magazine size
- Fixed an issue with unlocking one of the hidden skins where only one person would receive the skin instead of the entire lobby
- Slightly tweaked end of match music to end right as the match ends. Previously there was a few seconds of silence before the match actually ended
- Throwing axe should now have a different sound when hitting a player
- Fixed an issue in the lobby where changing a map, gamemode, or the lobby privacy settings would move your selected button down to start game when using a controller
- Fixed an issue where ammo pickups could be picked up when you had full ammo already
- Fixed an issue where rebinding on controllers would rebind the control, but also keep the original binding so both buttons performed the action
- Fixed an issue with rebinding where several controller controls were marked as keyboard controls, which led to players not being able to rebind those controls on controllers

[b]UI updates[/b]
- Added a message that pops up when a gun is out of ammo
- Added gun empty sound to the weapons
- Improved death cam for player ragdolls. The player will now follow the ragdoll instead of staring at the ground.
- Fixed an issue where weapon and ammo pickups wouldn't display the exact amount of ammo you received
- Weapons can now be selected on the weapon wheel using left click/A
- Changed how infinite ammo is displayed to only replace the weapons reserves with the infinity symbol
- Weapon wheel now displays infinite ammo properly

notes.title: DreadMoon Version 0.2r Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Content[/b]

[b]Game Modes[/b]
- [u]Seal the Deal[/u]: Team Deathmatch with constantly changing conditions for continual chaos.
- [u]Empowered[/u]: Team Deathmatch with only the empowered weapons.

[b]Maps[/b]
- [u]Sunken Castle[/u]: Fight for blood and honor in this flooded remnant of a castle lost to time.

[b]Skins[/b]
- Added community skin contest winner, unlocked by default.
- Added Blue, Pink, and Fox skins. Unlock methods hidden throughout the levels.

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Guns now deal equal damage to health and armor.
- Increased Pistol damage.
- Added ADS to Harpoon gun.
- Increased reload and melee animation speeds.
- Rebalanced Potions.

[b]Map Changes[/b]
- Major visual improvements to all maps.
- Significant lighting updates to all maps.
- Added new paintings, some with familiar faces!

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
- Resolved issues with keybindings and headshot damage consistency.
- Fixed melee weapons displaying ammo.
- Pausing no longer preserves momentum.
- Score no longer counts up post-round.
- Fixed “AlreadyRunning” Error.
- Potions no longer explode on invisible walls or bounce.
- Corrected functionality of Blessed potion.
- Updated Acid potion visuals.
- Potion visuals now consistent regardless of camera position.
- Volume sliders fully mute at 0.
- Vsync, FPS, and sensitivity settings persist across matches.
- Fixed Winchester ADS persistence.
- Resolved invisible gun pickups post-pickup.
- Joining Alpha matches no longer misassigns teams.
- Fixed lobby display of “all armor” on characters.
- Consistent display of Steam icon and profile name in lobbies.
- Aligned Alpha attack SFX with animation.

[b]Functionality Changes[/b]
- Invite friends from Steam friends list.
- Lobby hosts can kick players.
- Join games via Steam Friends List.

[b]UI[/b]
- Adjusted UI text sizes.
- Updated Cranked countdown timer for clarity.
- Centered specific text instances.
- Adjusted weapon wheel colors.
- Updated scoreboard to not cover pause menu; viewable when dead.
- Updated character customization icons.
- Added FPS Counter.
- Updated match result text.
- Revised grenade reticle.
- Adjusted crosshair sizes.
- Clarified dash icon recharge.
- Updated empowered weapon pickup icon.

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
- Improved Dash Visual Effect.
- Axe throwable now embeds on impact.
- Empowered weapons now have a golden shine.

notes.title: The Multiplayer Content Injection is here!
notes.notes:
We’ve been teasing it, you’re excited for it, and it’s finally here: The Great Content Injection™. In all seriousness, we’re super excited to be bringing DreadMoon multiplayer a ton of new features. What can you look forward to when the [b]update drops on January 31[/b]? 

[b]2 new game modes[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/1d2604e8df42fb8c668251bd8f2326346d21f58c.png[/img]
A Team Deathmatch with constantly changing conditions for constant chaos. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/d190e74b6ef55dac09f38f0bf6736d36f3f5b3ad.png[/img]
Traditional Team Deathmatch that you know and love, but only with the empowered weapons. 


[b]1 new map: Sunken Castle[/b]
Beneath the castle grounds lies the rest of the castle. Buried by a previous disaster, the area has been swallowed by the ground and fallen into ruin. It appears to have been occupied at some point, but whoever lived here left some time ago…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/0e652a3406b378c1eed097c2a662edc85c698a7f.png[/img]

[b]Community skin now available for use[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705042/2a9fae24ddd473f0a6dc9b88d956cd6277970010.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Unlockable skins are now unlockable[/b] 😉
Pay special attention when you’re exploring maps, you’ll never know what you might find!
Room hosts now have the ability to kick players from the room 
[*][b]BIG graphics update[/b]
This means improvements to lighting, updates to props and visuals, and additional paintings have been included, which may include some familiar faces! Additionally the Dash visual effect and cranked countdown timer have been updated for clarity, weapon wheel colors have been adjusted, a FPS Counter has been added, and many more small changes you’ll notice throughout the game. [/list]
As always, we really appreciate all of the feedback we have gotten over the past month and a half since multiplayer’s release. We’ve made a ton of improvements based on your feedback specifically, and we can’t wait for you to see the new and improved experience. 

What can you look forward to beyond this content injection? We’re hard at work on finishing up the co-op campaign for DreadMoon, so stay tuned for more updates. Additionally, [b]we’ll be hosting a tournament[/b] with YouTuber and Streamer ZlimBratSki in late February where teams will compete against each other to be the final teams in the bracket. The first place team will [b]each receive a Steam Deck[/b] and the second place team will each receive a [b]$50 Steam gift card[/b]. Stay tuned for the official announcement and sign up information.

notes.title: Happy New Year from the DreadMoon Team!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everyone! 

We hope you all enjoyed the holiday season. 2024 will be full of exciting developments for DreadMoon, and we’re so excited to start rolling more things out! What can you look forward to in the coming weeks? 

We will be launching our second Steam Deck giveaway next week, so make sure you’re in the Discord community for a chance to win. 

Back in December we launched our custom skin design competition for the chance to see your designs within DreadMoon. The finalists will be released next week for community voting! Stay tuned to our socials and Discord for information on how to vote. 

Finally, we’ll be releasing a major update to multiplayer later this month, which will include a brand new map and 2 additional game modes. We are also constantly working on improvements and fixing bugs to ensure the best experience for players. 

We hope you’re enjoying playing multiplayer DreadMoon, but stay tuned for our full co-op campaign, coming early this year.

notes.title: DreadMoon Holiday Update - Performance Boosts and Gameplay Tweaks!
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays, DreadMoon Community![/b]


We're thrilled to announce the release of our latest DreadMoon update, just in time for the holiday season. This update focuses on enhancing performance and fine-tuning gameplay for an even more thrilling experience. Check out the highlights:

---

[b]Key Updates:[/b]

- [b]Server Stability:[/b] Numerous fixes to ensure smoother, more stable gameplay.
- [b]Rendering Pipeline:[/b] Upgraded for optimized performance.
- [b]Weapon Balancing:[/b] Several adjustments for a more balanced combat experience.
- [b]Map Enhancements:[/b] Fixes and tweaks to improve overall performance and gameplay.
- [b]Movement: [/b]Enhanced fluidity and responsiveness in-game.

---

[b]Detailed Weapon Adjustments:[/b]

- [b]General:[/b]  - Movement speed decreased while carrying flag.
  - Blood raged players can't pick up empowered weapons.
- [b]Crossbow:[/b]
  - Increased fire rate.
- [b]Grenade Launcher:[/b]
  - Damage and force output increased.
- [b]Minigun:[/b]
  - Recoil and spread reduced, with improved hit detection.
- [b]Pistol:[/b]
  - Increased headshot damage.
- [b]Shotgun:[/b]
  - Adjusted damage fall-off and reduced damage.
  - Reserve ammo now limited to 8.
- [b]Empowered Weapons:[/b]
  - Various tweaks including ammo adjustments and damage enhancements.

---

[b]Map Specific Fixes:[/b]

- [b]Library:[/b] Performance improvements.
- [b]Mausoleum: [/b]Geometry fixes to prevent wall, stair, and pillar exploits.
- [b]Church: [/b]Collider fixes around trees and walls.
- [b]Town:[/b] Adjusted colliders for enhanced interaction.

---

[b]Additional Features:[/b]

- [b][/b]Achievements: Now visible in-game.
- Grenades can no longer pass through walls.
- Restrictions on flag pickup during certain animations.
- [b]Announcer Voice Lines: [/b]Limited continuous updates.
- [b]Input Changes:[/b] Enhanced for smoother movement.

---

We've spent a lot of time ensuring that we can address as many performance issues as possible! We hope you all enjoy some of these changes before the holiday season! We're dedicated to continually improving DreadMoon, and your feedback is invaluable. Enjoy the update and happy hunting! 

---

notes.title: Patch Notes for Build 0.1.1r Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Happy DreadMoon release day!

It’s been a great first day and we appreciate everyone who has taken some time today to play the game! We are aware of the performance issues some of you have experienced today, and we’re working towards fixes. Thank you all for being patient with us as we address them, and if you come across any additional bugs you would like to make us aware of, please send them in the “report a problem” channel on our Discord server. 

The following fixes have been made today and we’ll continue addressing stability issues this week.

Day 1 patch notes:
Occlusion culling added for each multiplayer map. This will help with performance while we work on other optimization fixes.
Private lobbies fixed
Armor bar properly updates after dying and respawning

Again, thank you to everyone who has played DreadMoon so far! As a reminder we will be rolling out our custom skin design competition this week and Steam deck giveaways next week, so stay tuned for more details.

notes.title: Gearing Up For DreadMoon!
notes.notes:
[b][Denver,  December 8, 2023][/b] — Hey everybody! We are thrilled to announce that DreadMoon is coming next week, December 12! Multiplayer gameplay of DreadMoon will be available Early Access on Steam for free, and we’re excited to bring everyone into the DreadMoon universe. 

Drawing inspiration from favorites like Halo and Doom, DreadMoon is a retro-inspired first-person shooter game where you play as Ulric, a powerful werewolf and right the wrongs your people made to free the land from the vampire lord Balthazar’s deadly clutches. While only multiplayer game play will be available at this time, you can look forward to a full co-op campaign mode coming in early 2024. 

DreadMoon introduces a diverse range of game modes and maps, providing you with a dynamic and engaging environment. The Early Access release will feature seven thrilling game modes, including classic favorites and unique offerings exclusive to DreadMoon, including:

[b]Free-for-all
Team Deathmatch
Capture the Flag
King of the Hill
Cranked
Sticks and Stones
Alpha
[/b]

The game also boasts an impressive arsenal of weapons, ensuring you have the tools needed to dominate the arena. Some of the weapons available in the game include the fully automatic crossbow, grenade launcher, harpoon launcher, minigun, pistol, shotgun/blunderbuss, and the iconic Winchester. 

You can create customizable lobbies or join already existing ones that can accommodate up to 8 people to join in the fun. Lobbies can be set as private for exclusive matches amongst friends or public for those seeking a challenge against opponents from around the world.

In addition to the diverse gameplay and weaponry, you can choose from five basic skin colors to customize your character. However, we have an exciting competition on the horizon. Players will have the opportunity to design their own skins, with the chance to see their creation become a permanent part of the game. To stay updated on this competition and more, players are encouraged to join the official [b][url=https://discord.gg/e3AJepGHtS]DreadMoon Discord server. [/url][/b]

To celebrate the launch, FatalFox Studios will be hosting [b]giveaways[/b] on the Discord server, featuring prizes such as gaming consoles. Don’t miss the chance to join the community, engage in competition, and be part of the DreadMoon experience. 

DreadMoon will be available on Steam starting [b]December 12, 2023[/b]. Get ready for an adrenaline-packed journey into the world of DreadMoon!
